item.title: ETH-Zurich: Engineering modular Photorhabdus Virulence Cassettes (PVCs) (2026) - Project Promotion
item.description:
**Title:** Engineering modular Photorhabdus Virulence Cassettes (PVCs)
**Description:** Introducing PVCs as a modular tool to deliver molecules into target cells. We want to describe the system we are working with and mention how we are improving it's specificity while setting up a platform future teams and researchers can easily use.
[Wiki](https://2026.igem.wiki/eth-zurich) | [Official Page](https://teams.igem.org/6289)
